newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moody's upgrades Scheider senior debt.
newsitem.headline: Moody's upgrades Scheider senior debt.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday it had upgraded Schneider SA's senior debt rating to A3 from Baa1.

"This rating action reflects Moody's expectation that Schneider's operating performance will continue to improve despite softness in certain markets, that its financial structure will benefit from on-going cashflow retention and recent asset disposals and that future acquisitions will be made without significant increases in debt leverage levels," it said in a statement.
The rating action, which applies to the 6.5-percent convertible Eurobond due 2000, concluded a review initiated on October 8, 1996.
